item.title: Sony Pushes PS5 Owners To Trade In Consoles Amid Unprecedented Price Hikes
item.description: The future of affordable video game consoles is not looking good, and hardware makers like Sony know it. The PlayStation 5 has undergone two major price hikes while the Xbox Series X has jumped in price three times in a single year. The AI-driven VRAM crisis at the heart of the issue is expected to worsen. Given the supply constraints, Sony has limited options for selling PS5s at prices customers might find acceptable.

item.title: For GTA 6, Xbox Put an Xbox Series X in an Alligator
item.description: Xbox has come up with a rather unusual way to celebrate Florida wildlife ahead of the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 launch, unveiling a custom Xbox Series X that looks like it has been swallowed whole by an alligator. Even stranger, the console inside actually works, and one lucky fan could soon have the bizarre gaming accessory sitting in their home.

item.title: Playstation Store Black Friday 2026 Sale Officially Revealed
item.description: Sony is starting the Black Friday festivities early this year. The company has revealed that PlayStation 's 2026 Black Friday Sale will start sooner than expected and last longer than usual. That means PlayStation 5 owners have plenty of time to take advantage of countless deals on games, including a handful of this year's GOTY contenders . There may be a downside, though, for anybody hoping for a discount on hardware.

item.title: Overwatch Mid-Season 5 Patch Notes Released With Big Tweaks
item.description: The penultimate season of Blizzard's big Overwatch revamp is coming to a close in the next few weeks, and Blizzard's got quite a lot more hero tweaks than usual in the mid-season patch notes. Some of them are minor, prompted by this season's changes to projectile sizes. Reaper's a big guy and an easier target now, for example, so Blizzard's bumped up his base health. Meanwhile, Illari's primary fire charge finally gets dropped a bit, and her healing pylon pumps out a bit more health. It's not quite the full kit overhaul folks have been asking for in the last few months, but it's a start.

item.title: The Elder Scroll 6: Sentinel's Name Quietly Teases Juicy 'Skyrim' Sequel
item.description: Eight years after the original announcement , we've finally learned the name of Bethesda's next RPG: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel . Since the developer didn't show any gameplay footage, all fans can really do is muse on the meaning of the title. As disappointing as that is, Elder Scrolls loreheads do have plenty to chew on.

item.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Director’s Next Movie Officially Picked up by Sony
item.description: The live-action Naruto movie is officially moving forward, thanks to some help from Sony. The anime adaptation from Destin Daniel Cretton ( Spider-Man: Brand New Day , Short Term 12 ) has been in the works at Lionsgate and is now set to begin production next year. This marks yet another collaboration between Cretton and Sony, a partnership that saw massive success this year with the latest Tom Holland Spider-Man movie.

item.title: D&D’s World of Warcraft Crossover Is the Bold Shake-Up the Game Needed
item.description: Wizards of the Coast has been playing things safe since updating the rules of Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition in 2024. After lead designers Jeremy Crawford and Chris Perkins left Wizards in 2025 to join Critical Role ’s Darrington Press, Wizards slowed the pace of new D&D releases. Recent books have focused mostly on updating the lore and rules for the game’s most popular campaign settings and rebalancing previously published character options. D&D’s newest release bucks the trend, delivering an ambitious collection of innovative character options, monsters, and ways to use some of the game’s less developed subsystems. It just requires venturing to a new world.
